summary: Financial accountant with CPA designation and over five years of experience in financial reporting and management accounting. Prepares group financial statements under IFRS-based accounting policies and manages high-volume royalty and licensing reporting for multiple international brands, verifying sales reports against contract terms and withholding tax obligations. Experienced in foreign currency management, bank reconciliation, general ledger maintenance, and accounts payable and receivable, with advanced Excel modeling and ERP proficiency. Works effectively in multicultural, cross-border teams and is bilingual in English and Mandarin Chinese.
